scenario: A call recorder app requests a permission set fully consistent with its stated function.

supported_findings: All requested permissions (RECORD_AUDIO, READ_PHONE_STATE, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) map directly to a call-recording function.
No network indicators or traffic_log entries are present, consistent with a purely local, offline recording function.
No findings in this case's artifacts indicate behavior beyond the app's stated purpose.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that recordings were transmitted off-device -- no network activity is present in this case at all.
Any claim about the content of any recorded call.
